liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Spanish Jam** (2 reviews): Listed among the highlights, along with the pre-drums jam and The Wheel; Spanish Jam into The Wheel is excellent, and the drums sit well in the mix [13][15]
- **Lost Sailor** (1 review): Brent's keyboard tone here was likened by someone to a dead pirate playing Davy Jones's bones [9]
- **Saint Of Circumstance** (1 review): About a three-minute uptempo jam after it resembles Dark Star; Brent and Bob keep going after Jerry leaves [6]
- **Jam** (1 review): Pre-drums jam picks up where the first-set Bird Song left off, with Mydland driving the syncopation [15]
- **The Wheel** (1 review): The Spanish Jam becomes a bit clunky going into The Wheel [11]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Garcia clearly raises the tempo in the transition from The Wheel into Sugar Magnolia [15]
- **Satisfaction** (1 review): The encore is high energy and excellent [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **New, New Minglewood Blues**: rare: 13 archived performances [17]

## The recordings

- **gd81-10-13.sbd.jim.13143.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 161 min; rated 4.29/5 by 7 [1]. Said about its sound: The soundboard sounds very good; Soundboard has some cuts, including an odd one near the end of To Lay Me Down; Brent's keyboards sound great [5][9]
- **gd81-10-13.aud.weiskircher-vernon.7496.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 167 min; rated 3.6/5 by 5 [3]. Said about its sound: Guitars sit lowest in the audience recording's mix, though it remains listenable; the soundboard is preferable overall; Audience recording has Phil up front and a good balance; the soundboard is called tinny, lacking low and mid range [6][10]
- **gd1981-10-13.sbd.128542.MrBill.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 156 min; rated 2/5 by 4 [4]. Said about its sound: This MrBill soundboard transfer is an improvement over earlier circulating versions [11]
- **gd1981-10-13.139556.sbd.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 22 songs; 160 min [2]

## Around the show

- Weir sings a shortened 'T for California' line in Minglewood, apparently struggling to say Russelsheim quickly [6]
- The second set rises in intensity compared with the well-played first set [5]
- The previous night, 10/12, was a better show than this one [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd81-10-13.sbd.jim.13143.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Soundboard source, transferred via Jim through cassette generations to WAV and SHN; origin before that unknown [1]
- **gd81-10-13.aud.weiskircher-vernon.7496.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [3]
- **gd1981-10-13.sbd.128542.MrBill.flac16**: transferred by Bill Guarneri; source: Recording and transfer info: SBD > MC > C > C (Maxell XL II) C > Pioneer deck > wav > Sound Forge 10 > TLH > flac [4]. Also: Hi-res remix version, compared with the 30 Trips Around the Sun material [12]
- **gd1981-10-13.139556.sbd.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set 1: SBD -> Cassette Master -> ? -> Dat -> CD (shnid=13143)Set 2: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/TDK SA-C90) [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1981-10-13 Tue Walter Köbel Halle, Rüsselsheim, Germany](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1415920224514/grateful-dead-1981-10-13-tue-walter) [18]

- Poster by Dennis Larkins: [1981 Grateful Dead Walter Kobel Hall Poster](https://results.concertpostergallery.com/lot/23616) [20]
